blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) has earned international recognition for its commitment to using lottery revenues to support public welfare and charitable causes. Speaking on the sidelines, World Lottery Association (WLA) President Andreas Kötter described Philippine lotteries as an outstanding example of responsible gaming and raising funds for good causes.
